This page lists the exact Glyphs MCP 2.0 callable surface. Input schemas
and enum values are published by MCP discovery; this table records stable
tool identity, effect, category, and intent.

| Tool | Effect | Category | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `get_server_info` | `read` | `server` | Read the v2 contract, exact loaded-code identity, permanent Python fallback, Knowledge version, host, and capabilities. |
| `list_documents` | `read` | `document` | List open Glyphs documents with stable process-local IDs. |
| `read_document` | `read` | `document` | Read canonical entities and computed observations through one selector and projection. |
| `evaluate_constraints` | `read` | `document` | Evaluate reusable field constraints without changing the document. |
| `preview_change` | `read` | `change` | Resolve exact targets and mechanically simulate generic operations into one immutable preview. |
| `apply_change` | `edit` | `change` | Apply one exact immutable preview through the verified transaction kernel without rerunning planning. |
| `get_operation` | `read` | `history` | Read one bounded operation or preview record. |
| `list_history` | `read` | `history` | List unsaved-session verified change commits. |
| `revert_change` | `edit` | `history` | Revert one compatible verified change without overwriting unrelated later edits. |
| `search_knowledge` | `read` | `knowledge` | Search the pinned offline font-design and Glyphs-coding corpus with citations and version filters. |
| `get_knowledge` | `read` | `knowledge` | Retrieve exact pinned Knowledge entries by stable ID. |
| `execute_python` | `code` | `python` | Permanent backup for Glyphs tasks not covered by declarative operations. Consult get_server_info.data.registries.pythonExecution before generating detached read-only or staged-document code. A stale optional fingerprint rebases read-only execution to the latest stable snapshot; staged writes remain strict. Live-open-world remains an explicit external-effect boundary. |
| `preview_export` | `read` | `export` | Create an immutable source-bundle export preview. |
| `apply_export` | `files` | `export` | Publish one exact reviewed source bundle. |
| `save_document` | `save` | `document` | Explicitly save or Save As with source and destination verification. |
| `open_document_view` | `ui` | `host` | Open exact glyphs in a Glyphs Edit tab without document mutation intent. |
| `get_runtime_status` | `read` | `runtime` | Read strict Python runtime-interlock health and recovery evidence. |
| `repair_runtime` | `code` | `runtime` | Repair manager-owned Python runtime-interlock state. |

## Shared mechanical vocabulary

- Canonical model schema: `7`.
- Entity kinds: `anchor`, `axis`, `class`, `document`, `feature`, `font`, `glyph`, `instance`, `kerning`, `layer`, `master`, `metric`, `node`, `number`, `prefix`, `shape`, `stem`.
- Change operations: `duplicate`, `insert`, `move`, `remove`, `set`, `translate`.
- Constraint operators: `eq`, `gt`, `gte`, `in_range`, `lt`, `lte`, `ne`, `within`.
- Computed projections: `alignment`, `bounds`, `compilation.diagnostics`, `geometry.counts`, `geometry.transform`, `grid`, `inheritance.metrics`, `metadata.effective`, `ownership`, `persistence`, `spacing.horizontal`, `spacing.vertical`.
- Selector predicates: `and`, `contains`, `eq`, `exists`, `gt`, `gte`, `in`, `lt`, `lte`, `ne`, `not`, `or`.
- Ordering modes: `auto`, `number`, `text`.
- Reducers: `all`, `any`, `average`, `count`, `max`, `min`, `sum`.
- Translation targets: `anchor`, `layer`, `node`, `shape`.
- Scalar entity value fields: `kerning` -> `value`.
  Scalar reads include this field when projection fields are omitted.
- Observation operands use `observation.<projection>.<path>`, for
  example `observation.bounds.x` or
  `observation.alignment.effectiveLayerAlignment`.

## Detached Python contract

- Inspect `get_server_info.data.registries.pythonExecution.detachedNamespace`
  before generating `read_only` or `staged_document` code.
- Reviewed baseline: Python `3.14`; import roots: `functools`, `itertools`, `json`, `math`, `re`, `statistics`.
- The registry publishes the exact built-ins, injected context, available
  constructors, denied capabilities, and contract fingerprint used by the
  runtime. Detached execution is not a security sandbox; the discarded
  clone and verified application are the safety boundary.
- A stale optional document fingerprint on `read_only` rebases to the
  latest stable snapshot and returns `read_rebased_to_current_document`;
  staged writes retain strict live-document fingerprint preconditions.
- `staged_symbol_unavailable`, `staged_import_unavailable`, and
  `staged_assertion_failed` distinguish contract mismatch and script
  validation from unclassified Python or host failures.

## Surface invariants

- The catalog contains exactly 18 tools.
- Knowledge supplies cited evidence, skills supply font-design and
  Glyphs expertise, and tools supply generic mechanics.
- Every document mutation is previewed against exact identities and a
  live-document fingerprint. `apply_change` consumes the stored patch without
  rerunning planning or staged Python.
- Native Glyphs saves are always allowed. They do not stale a preview
  unless the live canonical document also changed. Active transactions
  reconcile saved-before, saved-after, and saved-intermediate states.
- `save_document` alone enforces source and destination file overwrite
  preconditions. Live-document and file fingerprints are distinct.
- `execute_python` is a permanent fallback with `read_only`,
  `staged_document`, and `live_open_world` modes. Document-bound
  `read_only` code runs on a detached document and proves live purity.
- Knowledge is pinned and searched offline; updates occur only through
  reviewed deterministic builds.
- Saving, export publication, UI actions, runtime repair, and open-world
  Python remain explicit effect boundaries.
